tools.name: search_vehicles
tools.description: Search used vehicles in the De Autofinancier inventory. All filters are optional and freely combinable. Filter values are lowercase English codes; unknown values are silently ignored by the API (you will then get EVERYTHING back). Use list_filter_values first if you are not sure which codes to use.

tools.name: list_filter_values
tools.description: Returns all valid filter values (makes, models, colors, fuel types, etc.) from the official taxonomy. Use this before searching if you are not sure which code a make or model has — the API silently ignores invalid values.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_vehicles" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
